g.text: Where the two maps come from

g.text: Each map shows where asking for one digit changes the frozen model's noise guess. The checker gets the two maps and never the digit labels.

g.text: • A map's mean over the 2,048 pixels is 1, so its total size is divided out and only its shape is kept.

text.style: font-size: 9.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20313c

g.text: • The digit labels a and b enter only through which two U-Net calls are made. Swapping the asked pair swaps the channels.

text.style: font-size: 9.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #20313c

g.text: • In training the three calls run under torch.no_grad (v2_learn.py line 106), so no gradient reaches the U-Net there.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7a88
